comparison.objective: Advance a sheath over a guidewire without losing the wire, then withdraw it; candidate sets a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a deformable wire against sheath drag and perform constrained sliding versus coupled rotary screw/nut tool use.
comparison.success_condition: Sheath seated, wire not displaced prematurely, then withdrawn and released versus locked angle retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: The constraint-preservation theme is shared, but the actual physical ability is axial wire/sheath management rather than countertorque locking.
